method.baseline: Shipped browser: applySoccerFull v241:true; SOCCER_FULL.halfSeconds90; full default4-4-2; AIv2/rulesv1/feelv2/switchv23/airv23/v241 all enabled.
method.candidate: Same source and initial roster, config copy minigames.soccer.fullTune.halfSeconds=40, consumed by applySoccerFull; this does not edit game source.
method.ci: Exploratory percentile paired bootstrap, 2000 replicates, resampling seed blocks; aggregated stages/profiles share each seed block. Small seed count limits precision; no human calibration.
method.duration: Model simulation time including native stoppages; excludes renderer holds, load and bonus penalties.
method.modelRandom: Native createSoccer seededRandom default (Mulberry32), independent bot RNG; the browser session supplies context.seededRandom (LCG), so seed IDs do not promise exact browser replay. All gameplay flags and config transforms match browser defaults.
